name: Maya Lin
bio: Maya has spent the last eight years traveling with a 35L rucksack, a vintage rangefinder, and a relentless curiosity for remote cultures and high-altitude solitude.
quote: To travel is to discover that everyone is wrong about other countries. The real journey begins where the paved road ends.
gear: Leica M10-R · 35mm Summicron · Osprey Farpoint 40 · Moleskine Journal
